thuat_toan_quy_trinh: Buoc 1: Hieu Excel la chuong trinh bang tinh cua Microsoft gom cac o tao boi dong va cot, dung de ghi, trinh bay, tinh toan va thong ke.
Buoc 2: Nhan thuc tam quan trong: 90% nha quan ly gioi dung Excel, 85% nhan vien gioi thanh thao tin hoc van phong, moi nganh nghe va lua tuoi deu dung.

Buoc 3: Nam lo trinh 26 video: mo dau, thao tac file (bai 1), nhap lieu (bai 2), ham (bai 3-8), dinh dang/loc (bai 9-13), thu thuat (14-17), bieu do/in an/Pivot (18-20), mang/Dashboard/phim tat/Power Query/VBA (21-25).
Buoc 4: Chuan bi hoc: chon do phan giai HD 720p/1080p qua bieu tuong banh rang, chinh toc do phat phu hop.
Buoc 5: Cai Unikey tu unikey.vn dung ban 32/64-bit, bat che do V de go tieng Viet; cai Excel 2019 hoac toi thieu 2016.
Buoc 6: Tai file thuc hanh va cau hoi o phan mo ta duoi video (muc Xem them), giai nen va mo dung thu muc bai hoc.
Buoc 7: Nhan Subscribe va chuong de cap nhat video moi va ung ho kenh Ga Excel.
